name: Sakamoto Kenichi
source:
A cool and collected member of the Special Forces Unit Republic, who's able to keep his emotions in check despite sometimes feeling scared. [Spoiler]A former syndicate member, he had been drained of all hope and was willing to throw his life away.[/spoiler] 
He is grateful to [url=/c163256]Natsume Daigo[/url] for recruiting him and is willing to put his life in his hands.

[Edited from the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Kenichi_Sakamoto]Wiki[/url]]
